digest.component_or_area: CLI core dispatch and registry routing
propositions: Core top-level CLI execution must route through the selected registry lazy handler after the pre-operation help boundary, using only a closed set of adapter kinds (dispatcher, argv, argv_tracker, argv_tracker_root).
The router must preserve the original command remainder argv unchanged and ensure the selected S2 factory parses it exactly once without route-level option grammar or second parse.
Registry-derived mount/init behavior (none, init_only, full) and no-auto-mount selectors must match the pre-cutover census for all routes including conditional cases.

Confirmation context, global output extraction, legacy JSON shapes, token preservation after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation must maintain behavioral parity with existing implementations.

Bridge compatibility spellings must execute through approved adapters while purge-bridge remains unknown, and derived compatibility exports must remain valid for rollback without handler, help, or persisted-data changes.
